scripts.dev-clean: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.dev-seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec backend yarn db:seed
scripts.dev-test: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec backend yarn test
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && docker system prune -f
scripts.rebuild: docker compose down && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up
